description_en: Modifies the rule settings of Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)
description_zh: 修改云安全态势管理的规则设置
name: ModifyCheckRule

parameters.help_en: The rule ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2590599.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2590599.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The rule type. Default value: WHITE. Valid values:
WHITE: whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
规则类型。默认WHITE。取值：
WHITE：加白名单
parameters.name: rule_type

fields.help_en: The instance ID of the asset
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The region ID of the asset
fields.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The list of instances to be added in this rule update. If no instances need to be added, you do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 本次规则更新需要添加的实例列表，如果没有需要添加的实例可以不用传递此参数
parameters.name: add_instance_list

fields.help_en: The instance ID of the asset
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The region ID of the asset
fields.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The list of instances to be removed in this rule update. If no instances need to be removed, you do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 本次规则更新需要删除的实例列表，如果没有需要添加的实例可以不用传递此参数
parameters.name: delete_instance_list

parameters.help_en:
The effective scope of the modified rule. Valid values:
INSTNACE: instance.
ITEM: check item
parameters.help_zh:
修改规则的生效范围：
INSTNACE ：实例
ITEM：检查项
parameters.name: scope_type

parameters.help_en: The effective pattern of the whitelist rule. Valid values: PERMANENT (permanent, default value) and CUSTOM (custom effective period). If the value is CUSTOM, you must specify both EffectStartTime and EffectEndTime. After the modification, the server immediately recalculates the whitelist status based on the new effective period
parameters.help_zh: 加白规则的生效模式。取值：PERMANENT（永久生效，默认值）、CUSTOM（自定义生效时间）。取值为 CUSTOM 时，必须同时传入 EffectStartTime 和 EffectEndTime。修改后服务端立即按新的生效时间重算加白状态
parameters.name: effect_type

parameters.help_en: The effective start time of the whitelist rule. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is required when EffectType is set to CUSTOM, and the value must be less than or equal to the value of EffectEndTime
parameters.help_zh: 加白规则的生效开始时间，Unix 时间戳，单位：毫秒。EffectType 取值为 CUSTOM 时必填，且必须小于或等于 EffectEndTime
parameters.name: effect_start_time

parameters.help_en: The effective end time of the whitelist rule. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is required when EffectType is set to CUSTOM. The whitelist automatically expires after this time
parameters.help_zh: 加白规则的生效结束时间，Unix 时间戳，单位：毫秒。EffectType 取值为 CUSTOM 时必填，到期后加白自动失效
parameters.name: effect_end_time

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. This ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
